about_the_game:
Gourmet Steak Odyssey is a 2d platformer collectathon. Play as Sweet Baby Jesus as you carefully manage your two bullets and maneuver these insanely difficult levels. Collect the ingredients for the perfect steak, collect the pieces for the perfect puzzle, collect the fragments of your perfect plate, make those who have wronged you pay in blood and collect the perfect love of the lands. 

In this game you are allowed to run left, right and you're even allowed to jump. You also happen equipped with a gun that can shoot with so much recoil that you are sent backwards. BE CAREFUL! You only have 2 bullets before you need to reload! Use your bullets wisely! Most scholars recommend you don't waste your precious ammo on most of the pitiful enemies.

Key features

  • running

  • jumping

  • shooting

  • sliding

  • dancing

  • jumping

Traverse 12 worlds, each with their own ingredient and set of collectables. collect the collectables and prosper!

content_descriptors.notes: there is cartoon gore and some mild language so be warned
